name: nats-by-natan
description: NATS BY NATAN — aplikasi Android studi Alkitab (Ibrani/Yunani interlinear), Al-Qur'an, Ensiklopedia Hadits 9 Imam, leksikon, perpustakaan digital, dan pencarian terhubung Chrome.
author: Natan

scripts.check: node --check www/js/app.js && node --check server.js && node scripts/validate-data.js
scripts.android:debug: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
